description: This file defines the 'Display' class in the Drupal views_ui module, specifically for handling AJAX forms related to editing view displays. It includes methods for form construction, validation, and submission within the Drupal framework.

classes.name: Display
classes.description: A form class for editing Drupal view displays via AJAX, extending ViewsFormBase.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Display form object, optionally setting the type.

methods.name: getFormState
methods.description: Retrieves and sets the 'section' in the form state based on the view and display ID.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Builds and returns the form array for editing a view display.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Constructs the form elements for editing the view display, including options and override settings.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form options and triggers rerender if errors are present.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, saving options and caching the view.
